lr_fra_sync_seats = {
	clamp_variable = { var = LR_seats min = 0 max = 610 }
	set_variable = { LR_seats_opposition = 610 }
	subtract_from_variable = { LR_seats_opposition = LR_seats }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = LR_route_jacobin }
		set_variable = { LR_party_left = LR_seats }
		set_variable = { LR_party_centre = LR_seats_opposition }
		multiply_variable = { LR_party_centre = 0.39 }
		round_variable = LR_party_centre
		set_variable = { LR_party_right = LR_seats_opposition }
		subtract_from_variable = { LR_party_right = LR_party_centre }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = LR_route_girondin }
		set_variable = { LR_party_centre = LR_seats }
		set_variable = { LR_party_left = LR_seats_opposition }
		multiply_variable = { LR_party_left = 0.53 }
		round_variable = LR_party_left
		set_variable = { LR_party_right = LR_seats_opposition }
		subtract_from_variable = { LR_party_right = LR_party_left }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = LR_route_guardian }
		set_variable = { LR_party_centre = LR_seats }
		set_variable = { LR_party_left = LR_seats_opposition }
		multiply_variable = { LR_party_left = 0.53 }
		round_variable = LR_party_left
		set_variable = { LR_party_right = LR_seats_opposition }
		subtract_from_variable = { LR_party_right = LR_party_left }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = LR_route_marais }
		set_variable = { LR_party_right = LR_seats }
		set_variable = { LR_party_centre = LR_seats_opposition }
		multiply_variable = { LR_party_centre = 0.36 }
		round_variable = LR_party_centre
		set_variable = { LR_party_left = LR_seats_opposition }
		subtract_from_variable = { LR_party_left = LR_party_centre }
	}
	set_variable = { LR_seats_left = LR_party_left }
	set_variable = { LR_seats_edge = LR_party_left }
	add_to_variable = { LR_seats_edge = LR_party_centre }
}

lr_fra_sync_reform = {
	clamp_variable = { var = LR_tech_index min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = LR_cmd_index min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = LR_off_index min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { LR_dis_army_attack_factor = LR_tech_index }
	multiply_variable = { LR_dis_army_attack_factor = 0.002 }
	add_to_variable = { LR_dis_army_attack_factor = -0.2 }
	set_variable = { LR_dis_army_org_factor = LR_cmd_index }
	multiply_variable = { LR_dis_army_org_factor = 0.001 }
	add_to_variable = { LR_dis_army_org_factor = -0.1 }
	set_variable = { LR_dis_army_defence_factor = LR_cmd_index }
	multiply_variable = { LR_dis_army_defence_factor = 0.001 }
	add_to_variable = { LR_dis_army_defence_factor = -0.1 }
	set_variable = { LR_dis_training_time_factor = LR_off_index }
	multiply_variable = { LR_dis_training_time_factor = -0.002 }
	add_to_variable = { LR_dis_training_time_factor = 0.2 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { LR_tech_index > 99 }
			check_variable = { LR_cmd_index > 99 }
			check_variable = { LR_off_index > 99 }
		}
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = LR_dyn_disarmed }
	}
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

lr_fra_lay_rail = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { LR_rail_lines = 0 } }
		build_railway = {
			level = 1
			start_state = 16
			target_state = 29
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { LR_rail_lines = 1 } }
		build_railway = {
			level = 1
			start_state = 16
			target_state = 14
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { LR_rail_lines = 2 } }
		build_railway = {
			level = 1
			start_state = 16
			target_state = 19
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { LR_rail_lines = 3 } }
		build_railway = {
			level = 1
			start_state = 16
			target_state = 32
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { LR_rail_lines = 4 } }
		build_railway = {
			level = 1
			start_state = 32
			target_state = 21
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { LR_rail_lines = 5 } }
		build_railway = {
			level = 1
			start_state = 16
			target_state = 17
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { LR_rail_lines < 6 } }
		add_to_variable = { LR_rec_focus = 1.5 }
	}
	add_to_variable = { LR_rail_lines = 1 }
	clamp_variable = { var = LR_rail_lines min = 0 max = 6 }
	lr_fra_sync_industry = yes
}

lr_fra_road_works = {
	random_owned_controlled_state = {
		limit = { is_core_of = ROOT }
		add_building_construction = {
			type = infrastructure
			level = 1
			instant_build = yes
		}
	}
	add_to_variable = { LR_road_works = 1 }
	add_to_variable = { LR_rec_focus = 1 }
	lr_fra_sync_industry = yes
}

	}

lr_fra_finish_war = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				any_enemy_country = {
					NOT = { tag = ROOT }
					has_capitulated = no
				}
			}
		}
		log = "LR: last enemy has fallen, ending the war"
		every_enemy_country = {
			FRA = { white_peace = PREV }
		}
	}
}

lr_settle_germany = {
	log = "LR: German settlement begins"
	if = {
		limit = { 85 = { OR = { is_owned_by = GER } } }
		if = {
			limit = { POL = { exists = yes NOT = { has_war_with = FRA } } }
			POL = { transfer_state = 85 }
		}
		else = {
			FRA = { transfer_state = 85 }
			85 = { set_state_flag = LR_owed_POL }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 86 = { OR = { is_owned_by = GER } } }
		if = {
			limit = { POL = { exists = yes NOT = { has_war_with = FRA } } }
			POL = { transfer_state = 86 }
		}
		else = {
			FRA = { transfer_state = 86 }
			86 = { set_state_flag = LR_owed_POL }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 762 = { OR = { is_owned_by = GER } } }
		if = {
			limit = { POL = { exists = yes NOT = { has_war_with = FRA } } }
			POL = { transfer_state = 762 }
		}
		else = {
			FRA = { transfer_state = 762 }
			762 = { set_state_flag = LR_owed_POL }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 807 = { OR = { is_owned_by = GER } } }
		if = {
			limit = { POL = { exists = yes NOT = { has_war_with = FRA } } }
			POL = { transfer_state = 807 }
		}
		else = {
			FRA = { transfer_state = 807 }
			807 = { set_state_flag = LR_owed_POL }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 188 = { OR = { is_owned_by = GER } } }
		if = {
			limit = { POL = { exists = yes NOT = { has_war_with = FRA } } }
			POL = { transfer_state = 188 }
		}
		else = {
			FRA = { transfer_state = 188 }
			188 = { set_state_flag = LR_owed_POL }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 5 = { OR = { is_owned_by = GER } } }
		if = {
			limit = { POL = { exists = yes NOT = { has_war_with = FRA } } }
			POL = { transfer_state = 5 }
		}
		else = {
			FRA = { transfer_state = 5 }
			5 = { set_state_flag = LR_owed_POL }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 763 = { OR = { is_owned_by = GER } } }
		if = {
			limit = { POL = { exists = yes NOT = { has_war_with = FRA } } }
			POL = { transfer_state = 763 }
		}
		else = {
			FRA = { transfer_state = 763 }
			763 = { set_state_flag = LR_owed_POL }
		}
	}
	lr_german_exile = yes
	if = {
		limit = { 42 = { OR = { is_owned_by = GER } } }
		RHI = { transfer_state = 42 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 51 = { OR = { is_owned_by = GER } } }
		RHI = { transfer_state = 51 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 1089 = { OR = { is_owned_by = GER } } }
		RHI = { transfer_state = 1089 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 55 = { OR = { is_owned_by = GER } } }
		RHI = { transfer_state = 55 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 57 = { OR = { is_owned_by = GER } } }
		RHI = { transfer_state = 57 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 59 = { OR = { is_owned_by = GER } } }
		RHI = { transfer_state = 59 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 60 = { OR = { is_owned_by = GER } } }
		RHI = { transfer_state = 60 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 56 = { is_owned_by = GER } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = LR_route_empire has_country_flag = LR_route_red } }
			transfer_state = 56
		}
		else = {
			RHI = { transfer_state = 56 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 50 = { OR = { is_owned_by = GER } } }
		RHI = { transfer_state = 50 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 52 = { OR = { is_owned_by = GER } } }
		RHI = { transfer_state = 52 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 53 = { OR = { is_owned_by = GER } } }
		RHI = { transfer_state = 53 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 54 = { OR = { is_owned_by = GER } } }
		RHI = { transfer_state = 54 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 978 = { OR = { is_owned_by = GER } } }
		RHI = { transfer_state = 978 }
	}
	GER = {
		every_owned_state = {
			RHI = { transfer_state = PREV }
		}
	}
	85 = { log = "LR: German settlement: state 85 owner [THIS.Owner.GetTag] controller [THIS.Controller.GetTag]" }
	51 = { log = "LR: German settlement: state 51 owner [THIS.Owner.GetTag] controller [THIS.Controller.GetTag]" }
	53 = { log = "LR: German settlement: state 53 owner [THIS.Owner.GetTag] controller [THIS.Controller.GetTag]" }
	286 = { log = "LR: German settlement: state 286 owner [THIS.Owner.GetTag] controller [THIS.Controller.GetTag]" }
	log = "LR: German settlement finished"
	RHI = {
		set_capital = { state = 51 }
		set_politics = {
			ruling_party = neutrality
			elections_allowed = no
		}
	}
	set_autonomy = {
		target = RHI
		autonomous_state = autonomy_puppet
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = LR_bavaria_defeated }
		lr_unify_germany = yes
	}
}

lr_unify_germany = {
	if = {
		limit = { BAY = { exists = yes } }
		BAY = {
			every_owned_state = {
				RHI = { transfer_state = PREV }
			}
		}
	}
	RHI = { set_capital = { state = 51 } }
	set_country_flag = LR_germany_unified
	news_event = { id = lr_news.14 days = 1 }
}

lr_settle_austria = {
	log = "LR: Austrian settlement begins"
	if = {
		limit = { 88 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		if = {
			limit = { POL = { exists = yes NOT = { has_war_with = FRA } } }
			POL = { transfer_state = 88 }
		}
		else = {
			FRA = { transfer_state = 88 }
			88 = { set_state_flag = LR_owed_POL }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 89 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		if = {
			limit = { POL = { exists = yes NOT = { has_war_with = FRA } } }
			POL = { transfer_state = 89 }
		}
		else = {
			FRA = { transfer_state = 89 }
			89 = { set_state_flag = LR_owed_POL }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 91 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		if = {
			limit = { POL = { exists = yes NOT = { has_war_with = FRA } } }
			POL = { transfer_state = 91 }
		}
		else = {
			FRA = { transfer_state = 91 }
			91 = { set_state_flag = LR_owed_POL }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { TTS = { exists = yes OR = { is_subject_of = FRA is_in_faction_with = FRA } } }
	if = {
		limit = { 159 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		TTS = { transfer_state = 159 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 1139 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		TTS = { transfer_state = 1139 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 160 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		TTS = { transfer_state = 160 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 1113 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		TTS = { transfer_state = 1113 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 39 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		TTS = { transfer_state = 39 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 850 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		TTS = { transfer_state = 850 }
	}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { ITA = { exists = yes OR = { is_subject_of = FRA is_in_faction_with = FRA } } }
	if = {
		limit = { 159 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		ITA = { transfer_state = 159 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 1139 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		ITA = { transfer_state = 1139 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 160 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		ITA = { transfer_state = 160 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 1113 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		ITA = { transfer_state = 1113 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 39 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		ITA = { transfer_state = 39 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 850 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		ITA = { transfer_state = 850 }
	}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { PAP = { exists = yes OR = { is_subject_of = FRA is_in_faction_with = FRA } } }
	if = {
		limit = { 159 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		PAP = { transfer_state = 159 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 1139 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		PAP = { transfer_state = 1139 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 160 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		PAP = { transfer_state = 160 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 1113 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		PAP = { transfer_state = 1113 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 39 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		PAP = { transfer_state = 39 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 850 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		PAP = { transfer_state = 850 }
	}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { TOS = { exists = yes OR = { is_subject_of = FRA is_in_faction_with = FRA } } }
	if = {
		limit = { 159 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		TOS = { transfer_state = 159 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 1139 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		TOS = { transfer_state = 1139 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 160 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		TOS = { transfer_state = 160 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 1113 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		TOS = { transfer_state = 1113 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 39 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		TOS = { transfer_state = 39 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { 850 = { OR = { is_owned_by = AUS } } }
		TOS = { transfer_state = 850 }
	}
	}
	AUS = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
			leave_faction = yes
		}
	}
	white_peace = AUS
	AUS = {
		every_enemy_country = {
			AUS = { white_peace = PREV }
		}
	}
	89 = { log = "LR: Austrian settlement: state 89 owner [THIS.Owner.GetTag] controller [THIS.Controller.GetTag]" }
	159 = { log = "LR: Austrian settlement: state 159 owner [THIS.Owner.GetTag] controller [THIS.Controller.GetTag]" }
	4 = { log = "LR: Austrian settlement: state 4 owner [THIS.Owner.GetTag] controller [THIS.Controller.GetTag]" }
	log = "LR: Austrian settlement finished"
	set_autonomy = {
		target = AUS
		autonomous_state = autonomy_puppet
	}
	AUS = { lr_fra_name_puppet = yes }
}

lr_settle_britain = {
	log = "LR: British settlement begins"
	if = {
		limit = { CAN = { is_subject_of = ENG } }
		ENG = { end_puppet = CAN }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { USA = { is_subject_of = ENG } }
		ENG = { end_puppet = USA }
		CAN = {
			set_autonomy = {
				target = USA
				autonomous_state = autonomy_dominion
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { AST = { is_subject_of = ENG } }
		ENG = { end_puppet = AST }
		CAN = {
			set_autonomy = {
				target = AST
				autonomous_state = autonomy_dominion
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NZL = { is_subject_of = ENG } }
		ENG = { end_puppet = NZL }
		CAN = {
			set_autonomy = {
				target = NZL
				autonomous_state = autonomy_dominion
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { SAF = { is_subject_of = ENG } }
		ENG = { end_puppet = SAF }
		CAN = {
			set_autonomy = {
				target = SAF
				autonomous_state = autonomy_dominion
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { RAJ = { is_subject_of = ENG } }
		ENG = { end_puppet = RAJ }
		CAN = {
			set_autonomy = {
				target = RAJ
				autonomous_state = autonomy_dominion
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { MAL = { is_subject_of = ENG } }
		ENG = { end_puppet = MAL }
		CAN = {
			set_autonomy = {
				target = MAL
				autonomous_state = autonomy_dominion
			}
		}
	}
	ENG = {
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { is_core_of = ENG }
				NOT = { is_on_continent = europe }
			}
			CAN = { transfer_state = PREV }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
			leave_faction = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_war_with = ENG }
		white_peace = ENG
	}
	ENG = {
		every_enemy_country = {
			ENG = { white_peace = PREV }
		}
	}
	set_autonomy = {
		target = ENG
		autonomous_state = autonomy_puppet
	}
	ENG = { lr_fra_name_puppet = yes }
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_war_with = FRA
			OR = {
				tag = CAN
				is_subject_of = CAN
			}
		}
		FRA = { white_peace = PREV }
	}
	126 = { log = "LR: British settlement: state 126 owner [THIS.Owner.GetTag] controller [THIS.Controller.GetTag]" }
	276 = { log = "LR: British settlement: state 276 owner [THIS.Owner.GetTag] controller [THIS.Controller.GetTag]" }
	281 = { log = "LR: British settlement: state 281 owner [THIS.Owner.GetTag] controller [THIS.Controller.GetTag]" }
	log = "LR: British settlement finished"
}

lr_settle_canada = {
	if = {
		limit = { AST = { is_subject_of = CAN } }
		CAN = { end_puppet = AST }
	}
	CAN = {
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_core_of = CAN } }
			AST = { transfer_state = PREV }
		}
	}
}

lr_fra_pay_owed = {
	if = {
		limit = { POL = { exists = yes OR = { is_in_faction_with = FRA is_subject_of = FRA } } }
		FRA = {
			every_owned_state = {
				limit = { has_state_flag = LR_owed_POL }
				clr_state_flag = LR_owed_POL
				POL = { transfer_state = PREV }
			}
		}
	}
}

lr_fra_monthly = {
	lr_fra_pay_owed = yes
	lr_fra_sync_industry = yes
	set_variable = { LR_pk_hands_left = 3 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = LR_route_jacobin
				has_country_flag = LR_route_girondin
				has_country_flag = LR_route_marais
				has_country_flag = LR_route_guardian
			}
		}
		lr_fra_campaign_monthly = yes
		add_to_variable = { LR_election_clock = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_election_clock > 23 } }
			set_variable = { LR_election_clock = 0 }
			country_event = { id = lr_election.1 days = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = LR_threat_conservative
				has_country_flag = LR_threat_revolutionary
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = LR_resistance_uprooted } }
			add_to_variable = { LR_op_paris = 2 }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = LR_op_paris min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_op_paris > 99 } }
			set_variable = { LR_op_paris = 60 }
			add_to_variable = { LR_uprisings = 1 }
			country_event = { id = lr_france.40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = LR_resistance_uprooted } }
			add_to_variable = { LR_op_nord = 2 }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = LR_op_nord min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_op_nord > 99 } }
			set_variable = { LR_op_nord = 60 }
			add_to_variable = { LR_uprisings = 1 }
			country_event = { id = lr_france.40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = LR_resistance_uprooted } }
			add_to_variable = { LR_op_vendee = 2 }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = LR_op_vendee min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_op_vendee > 99 } }
			set_variable = { LR_op_vendee = 60 }
			add_to_variable = { LR_uprisings = 1 }
			country_event = { id = lr_france.40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = LR_resistance_uprooted } }
			add_to_variable = { LR_op_midi = 2 }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = LR_op_midi min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_op_midi > 99 } }
			set_variable = { LR_op_midi = 60 }
			add_to_variable = { LR_uprisings = 1 }
			country_event = { id = lr_france.40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = LR_resistance_uprooted } }
			add_to_variable = { LR_op_rhone = 2 }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = LR_op_rhone min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_op_rhone > 99 } }
			set_variable = { LR_op_rhone = 60 }
			add_to_variable = { LR_uprisings = 1 }
			country_event = { id = lr_france.40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = LR_resistance_uprooted } }
			add_to_variable = { LR_op_lorraine = 2 }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = LR_op_lorraine min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_op_lorraine > 99 } }
			set_variable = { LR_op_lorraine = 60 }
			add_to_variable = { LR_uprisings = 1 }
			country_event = { id = lr_france.40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = LR_resistance_uprooted } }
			add_to_variable = { LR_op_africa = 2 }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = LR_op_africa min = 0 max = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_op_africa > 99 } }
			set_variable = { LR_op_africa = 60 }
			add_to_variable = { LR_uprisings = 1 }
			country_event = { id = lr_france.40 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_idea = LR_FRA_resistance_high }
				OR = {
				check_variable = { LR_op_paris > 69 }
				check_variable = { LR_op_nord > 69 }
				check_variable = { LR_op_vendee > 69 }
				check_variable = { LR_op_midi > 69 }
				check_variable = { LR_op_rhone > 69 }
				check_variable = { LR_op_lorraine > 69 }
				check_variable = { LR_op_africa > 69 }
				}
			}
			add_ideas = LR_FRA_resistance_high
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_idea = LR_FRA_resistance_high
				check_variable = { LR_op_paris < 70 }
				check_variable = { LR_op_nord < 70 }
				check_variable = { LR_op_vendee < 70 }
				check_variable = { LR_op_midi < 70 }
				check_variable = { LR_op_rhone < 70 }
				check_variable = { LR_op_lorraine < 70 }
				check_variable = { LR_op_africa < 70 }
			}
			remove_ideas = LR_FRA_resistance_high
		}
		lr_fra_sync_opposition = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = LR_petain_coup_done }
			has_capitulated = no
			OR = { has_country_flag = LR_route_orleans has_country_flag = LR_route_bourbon has_country_flag = LR_route_communist has_country_flag = LR_route_anarchist has_country_flag = LR_route_jacobin has_country_flag = LR_route_girondin has_country_flag = LR_route_marais has_country_flag = LR_route_napoleon has_country_flag = LR_route_empire has_country_flag = LR_route_guardian has_country_flag = LR_route_red }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { LR_hot = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_op_paris > 79 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { LR_hot = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_op_nord > 79 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { LR_hot = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_op_vendee > 79 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { LR_hot = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_op_midi > 79 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { LR_hot = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_op_rhone > 79 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { LR_hot = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_op_lorraine > 79 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { LR_hot = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_op_africa > 79 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { LR_hot = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					check_variable = { LR_hot > 2 }
					check_variable = { LR_uprisings > 2 }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = LR_petain_coup_done
			country_event = { id = lr_novel.1001 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_country_flag = LR_route_jacobin
				has_country_flag = LR_route_girondin
				has_country_flag = LR_route_marais
				has_country_flag = LR_route_guardian
			}
			check_variable = { LR_seats > 100 }
		}
		set_variable = { LR_seat_loss = 6 }
		# The larger the government, the more it has to lose.
		set_variable = { LR_seat_excess = LR_seats }
		subtract_from_variable = { LR_seat_excess = 244 }
		clamp_variable = { var = LR_seat_excess min = 0 max = 610 }
		multiply_variable = { LR_seat_excess = 0.03 }
		add_to_variable = { LR_seat_loss = LR_seat_excess }
		# Unrest feeds the opposition.
		if = {
			limit = { has_stability < 0.5 }
			add_to_variable = { LR_seat_loss = 4 }
		}
		# Each restless region sends its own deputies to the opposition.
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_op_paris > 60 } }
			add_to_variable = { LR_seat_loss = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_op_nord > 60 } }
			add_to_variable = { LR_seat_loss = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_op_vendee > 60 } }
			add_to_variable = { LR_seat_loss = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_op_midi > 60 } }
			add_to_variable = { LR_seat_loss = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_op_rhone > 60 } }
			add_to_variable = { LR_seat_loss = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_op_lorraine > 60 } }
			add_to_variable = { LR_seat_loss = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_op_africa > 60 } }
			add_to_variable = { LR_seat_loss = 1 }
		}
		# A war the country is tired of, or losing, empties the government benches.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_war = yes
				has_war_support < 0.5
			}
			add_to_variable = { LR_seat_loss = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { surrender_progress > 0.1 }
			add_to_variable = { LR_seat_loss = 4 }
		}
		round_variable = LR_seat_loss
		subtract_from_variable = { LR_seats = LR_seat_loss }
		clamp_variable = { var = LR_seats min = 100 max = 610 }
		lr_fra_sync_seats = yes
		# Without a majority the cabinet governs badly, and in time the Chamber brings it down. Only the three
		# parliaments suffer it; Napoleon's president keeps his seat count for his focuses but no minority penalty.
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { LR_seats < 306 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = LR_route_guardian }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = LR_FRA_minority } }
				add_ideas = LR_FRA_minority
				set_variable = { LR_minority_months = 0 }
			}
			add_to_variable = { LR_minority_months = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { LR_minority_months > 5 } }
				set_variable = { LR_minority_months = 0 }
				country_event = { id = lr_election.2 days = 1 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = LR_FRA_minority }
			remove_ideas = LR_FRA_minority
			set_variable = { LR_minority_months = 0 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_idea = LR_FRA_minority
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = LR_route_jacobin
					has_country_flag = LR_route_girondin
					has_country_flag = LR_route_marais
				}
			}
		}
		remove_ideas = LR_FRA_minority
		set_variable = { LR_minority_months = 0 }
	}
}
